summary: Fortinet FortiCNAPP cloud protection platform (formerly Lacework) for AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Kubernetes: configuration, vulnerabilities, access rights and runtime threats.
value: Cloud and Kubernetes misconfigurations are visible together with compliance checks.
The agent spots threats on servers and in containers at runtime.
Excessive cloud permissions are found and cut back.
simple: Fortinet’s cloud security platform (formerly Lacework) for AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Kubernetes — the Risk & Threat license, priced by number of cloud resources, with all capabilities. Discovers resources and checks configuration (CSPM, KSPM) and compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI, NIST and CIS; scans containers, hosts and infrastructure-as-code templates for vulnerabilities and exposed secrets and checks open-source components (SCA, SBOM); cuts excessive cloud permissions (CIEM); the agent monitors servers and containers at runtime, checks file integrity and keeps unsafe images out of Kubernetes. Polygraph learns normal behavior on its own and alerts only on anomalies, while Exposure Polygraph shows attack paths. Finds and classifies sensitive data in S3 and Azure Blob (DSPM). Web application testing (FortiDAST) costs extra, and Code Security is a separate purchase.
notIncluded: Web application testing (FortiDAST) costs extra; Code Security is a separate purchase.
classification: One product, the Risk & Threat licence with everything: CSPM/KSPM, IaC and DSPM are CNAPP; the runtime agent with FIM is CWPP; CIEM is CIEM.
Legacy per-vCPU pricing is not included.
